idea-plugin.name: CodeInsight
idea-plugin.description:
Structural code review for Python projects inside the IDE: function-level changes, callers and impact, duplicate implementations and intent drift, rendered by the local codeinsight serve web UI.

Requires Node.js 22.13 or newer and npm install -g codeinsight.

在 IDE 里审查未提交改动：函数级改动、调用方和影响面、重复实现、意图偏离。需要本机安装 Node ≥ 22.13 和 codeinsight。

action.description: 用 CodeInsight 审查工作区里未提交的改动
